answer: Cross-context residual audit fits a ridge model to each identity’s post-payout interaction traces. Identities whose residuals correlate above threshold across unrelated tasks are frozen and rewards clawed back until review. Calibration on an orchard telemetry cohort sets thresholds and estimates false positives. A yarrow-planted sensor feed checks drift; each attacker identity still needs about 40 varied interactions and $80 of API traffic to avoid flagging.
